response.sql:
WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.points) AS average_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
  country,
  average_points,
  average_wins,
  average_wins - AVG(average_wins) OVER () AS average_wins_minus_country_mean
FROM country_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Countries with no constructor standings records are omitted because their averages are undefined; NULL country values, if present, are grouped together as a country value.
